ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white/light grey) pixels dominate approximately 85-90% of the visible surface, contrasted by low-intensity (black) pixels along the perimeter and central axis.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity (black) banding along the trailing edge and lobe tips. A vertical, irregular cluster of low-intensity focal spots is positioned along the central longitudinal axis extending from the fluke base toward the notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 35 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) distributed uniformly along the entire trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer edges exhibit a wide convex sweep transitioning to a mild concavity as the contour approaches the central median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, low-contrast dimples and pitted clusters (diameter approx. 15-25 pixels) scattered across the mid-region of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, short, dark linear pixel disruption visible on the right lobe, mid-depth, oriented horizontally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular, segmented black pigmentation/scarring cluster at the central base; multiple circular healed lesions consistent with past barnacle colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique vertical segmented pigmentation pattern on the central keel, appearing as a series of dark 'dashes' between the lobes.
